ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 60% of the visible fluke surface; low-intensity black pixels occupy approximately 40%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Image-left lobe features a predominantly white field with dense black mottling along the trailing edge and a single distinct dark focal spot. Image-right lobe features a large solid black central region transitioning to a white distal field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire trailing edge, with significant pixel-level variation caused by attached biological clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature from notch to distal tips; sweep is highly irregular and interrupted by three-dimensional protrusions at the lateral boundaries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive clusters of circular, high-contrast, tan-white pixel groupings (barnacles) localized along the entire trailing edge boundary and both distal lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the white field of the image-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy peripheral colonization of barnacle clusters along all visible trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, prominent, isolated dark circular pigmentation spot on the central white field of the image-left lobe.
